description: Turn on Encrypted Anti-Download (HLS encryption) on existing videos, 1–100 per call (one video works too). PAID in credits, per video: ceil(duration in hours × number of current qualities), e.g. a 10-minute video in 3 qualities = 1 credit; charged when the video is queued. Cannot be undone: there is no way to decrypt a video. Only for Gold/Enterprise plans or accounts with the 'Anti-Download Criptografado' add-on (checked before sending; otherwise refused). Videos already encrypted are left out (checked before sending) and listed in skipped as already_encrypted. Videos are also skipped without charge when still processing, with a pending partial deletion, without duration/qualities, not found, or when the credit balance doesn't cover them (insufficient_funds). Returns {idempotency_key, total, queued, skipped: [{video_id, reason}]}; follow the progress with panda_get_hls_encryption_batches. To encrypt future uploads automatically use panda_set_new_uploads_encryption.
name: panda_encrypt_videos
title: Encrypt Videos (HLS)
